data.narrative:
Havoc AI is a Series A–stage frontier-tech company operating in the Ocean & Maritime sector, founded by Paul Lwin and Joe Turner. The company has raised $200M to date. The comparable universe consists of two private peers—Seasats and Bedrock Ocean—with no public comps available in this emerging subsector.

The valuation analysis employs stage-progression methodology, which is the applicable triangulation approach given data availability. Using total capital raised ($200M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, this method yields an implied post-money valuation of $400M. This represents the median point in the triangulated range.

The analysis supports a valuation band of $340M to $460M, with a central estimate of $400M. Material uncertainty stems from the limited comparable dataset (two private peers, zero public benchmarks), which constrains cross-validation. The stage-progression method relies on historical multiplier patterns and assumes the company's risk and growth profile align with cohort norms. Refinement of this range would benefit from expanded peer data or additional valuation signals such as revenue multiples or growth rates, which are not present in the current dataset.
